key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders priced in further RBA rate hikes, with Greg Jericho urging caution before another increase given a stalling economy (#35, #74)
Aussie banks forecast record house price falls; CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget, signalling a deepening housing correction (#63, #65)
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle, offering a small positive for junior miners (#37, #68)
Bathla's collapse exposes systemic fragility in Australia's construction sector, described as symptomatic of a 'Ponzi economy' (#31, #38)
Global AI capex cycle accelerates: Nvidia acquires Hugging Face for $12.9B, Broadcom forecasts steep AI revenue ramp, HPE raises outlook on record AI server demand (#55, #53, #45)
ASIC launches review of whistleblower complaints at Big Four accounting firms, raising governance overhang on listed companies (#39)
Energy transition costs mounting; TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo flagged to break gas cartel pricing (#70, #67, #72)
ASX small-caps active: Kaoko Metals, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice Minerals, Power Minerals, and Aurum (gold) among notable movers (#25, #26, #27)

sectors.trend: Under pressure from record house price fall forecasts, 15% drop in home loan applications, and ASIC scrutiny of accounting partners. CBA and WBC face margin pressure from a legal loophole allowing higher fees on loyal customers.
sectors.implications: NIM compression and credit-loss provisions likely to rise. CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face headwinds; defensive dividend yields remain attractive but capital returns may be curtailed.

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout underway amid geopolitical conflict; Macarthur (MAC.AX) clears WA bulk test. Junior miners (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength. Aurum adds West African gold ounces.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore price softness. Gold and critical-mines juniors offer diversification. Monitor iron ore contract pricing and China demand signals.

sectors.trend: Energy transition costs 'running off the rails'; TMK Energy gas rates surge; Beetaloo (BTL.AX) flagged to disrupt gas cartel pricing. EV adoption overtakes petrol cars domestically.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, SXG.AX, BTL.AX benefit from gas price strength. WES.AX, AGL.AX face transition-cost overhang. EV shift pressures oil-linked equities long-term.

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals sector-wide distress; Melbourne councils admit inability to cope with planned population growth; housing construction to follow prices lower.
sectors.implications: WTC.AX, GPT.AX, and construction-linked REITs face demand risk. Government infrastructure spend may provide partial offset. High default risk in mid-tier builders.

sectors.trend: Nvidia acquires Hugging Face ($12.9B); Broadcom forecasts steep AI revenue ramp; HPE raises fiscal outlook; AI boom 'isn't over yet' per Nvidia commentary.
sectors.implications: Positive for global tech sentiment and AUD via risk appetite. Limited direct ASX exposure but supports CSL.AX (biotech-adjacent) and any ASX-listed AI/data-centre plays. Data-centre community opposition (#69) a minor risk.

sectors.trend: EV sales outpace petrol cars as Australians dodge fuel costs; Hilton Food upgrades guidance; Qantas A380 to bring NFL 49ers to Australia.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX benefit from consumer shift. QAN.AX gains from NFL event. Fuel-cost sensitivity supports EV-adjacent names.

key_themes: RBA rate path uncertainty and housing credit contraction
Iron ore structural shakeout vs. junior miner resilience
Energy transition cost overhang and gas pricing
ASIC regulatory scrutiny of Big Four accountants
Political instability (One Nation gains, Albo rhetoric) affecting policy confidence
EV adoption inflection point in Australia

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA further rate hike despite stalling economy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate sensitivity via long-duration bonds; reduce leverage in rate-sensitive REITs and construction names.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing price correction and credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight banks' mortgage book exposure; favour capital-returns-focused banks (CBA.AX) over growth lenders; monitor NIM and provision trends.
Avoid mid-tier builders; favour government-backed infrastructure contracts; monitor WTC.AX and GPT.AX order books.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price weakness masked by geopolitics
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure; favour gold (Aurum) and critical-mines juniors; monitor 62% Fe contract pricing.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ASIC regulatory action on Big Four accountants
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review audit quality of holdings; favour companies with Big Four independence; monitor for restatement risk.
Maintain diversified portfolio; avoid over-concentration in policy-sensitive sectors (housing, immigration-linked construction).

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-mines juniors as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore shakeout pressures BHP/RIO/FMG; gold (Aurum) and vanadium/critical-mines names offer relative strength and inflation hedge.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective bank exposure focused on capital returns
opportunities.rationale: Despite housing headwinds, CBA and WBC maintain strong capital positions; dividend yields remain attractive in a higher-rate environment.
TMK gas rate surge and Beetaloo cartel-breaking thesis support upstream gas names; EV shift creates structural demand for gas-powered generation.
Nvidia-Hugging Face deal, Broadcom AI ramp, and HPE upgrade confirm AI capex cycle intact; limited direct ASX exposure warrants global tech ETF allocation.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to construction and housing-linked REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse, 15% drop in loan applications, and record house price fall forecasts create downside risk for builders and property trusts.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with long-duration bonds or inverse rate ETFs
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX closed lower on rate-hike fears; RBA may hike despite weak growth, creating a stagflationary risk for equities.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight pure iron ore majors pending price stabilisation
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural shakeout in iron ore masked by geopolitical conflict; BHP/RIO/FMG margins under pressure until demand recovers.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in the 1–3 month window. RBA rate-hike expectations, housing credit contraction, and construction-sector contagion (Bathla) weigh on sentiment. The 'bull case returns' narrative (#40) is offset by stalling growth and record house price fall forecasts. Expect volatility around RBA communications and any ASIC enforcement actions. Iron ore weakness caps materials sector upside.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if the RBA pauses or pivots. AI capex super-cycle (Nvidia, Broadcom, HPE) supports global risk appetite and AUD. Energy transition and critical-mines themes offer structural growth. However, housing correction and construction fragility could persist, requiring policy intervention. Canada outperforming Australia on per-capita growth (#42) highlights structural productivity concerns.
